business_summary: Daido Steel Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of steel products in Japan and internationally. The company offers specialty steel for automotive parts, industrial machinery parts, electrical machinery parts, construction, and tool steel; stainless steel, nickel-based alloys, electrical and electronics parts, and magnetic material products; alloy powder; titanium products; and welding wire. It is also involved in manufacturing of specialty steel products and materials; distribution; sales of raw materials; real estate, insurance, and analysis businesses; and provision of transportation and logistics, machine maintenance, welfare, and golf course management services. In addition, the company provides die forging, precise hot forging, and welded parts; parts for boats and ships, industrial machines, heavy electric machines, steel making equipment, chemical equipment, oil drilling rigs, and spacecraft and aircraft; manganese railway rails, components for automobiles, industrial machine, electric machine and furnaces, and advanced cast steel products; automotive, industrial machine, electric machine, telecommunications equipment; and lumber industry band saws, engine valves, compressors, hydraulic equipment, and machine tool parts. Further, it offers steel making equipment, industrial furnaces and facilities, and environmental equipment. Additionally, the company provides tool steel and steel for molds, superalloy, strip, formed and fabricated products, target material, new metal, point light source LEDs, permalloy foil, isotropic SmFeN magnetic powder and compounds, and material for semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Daido Steel Co., Ltd. was founded in 1916 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.
